name: Exp_ReOpenPositions
summary: This EA is a utility tool that re-opens positions after they are closed, either manually or by stop loss/take profit hits. It monitors closed positions and replicates them with the same direction, volume, and instrument, functioning as a position recovery or persistence tool rather than a strategy-based trading system.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个工具类程序，用于在仓位被关闭后重新开仓，无论是手动平仓还是止损/止盈触发。它监控已平仓位并以相同方向、手数和品种复制开仓，作为仓位恢复或持久化工具而非策略型交易系统。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非基于市场信号驱动的策略交易程序，而是一个仓位管理工具。其核心概念是在仓位被关闭后自动重新开立相同方向的仓位，实现仓位的持续维持。入场条件并非基于技术指标或市场分析，而是基于检测到仓位被关闭的事件触发。出场条件同样不涉及策略性退出逻辑，仓位仅在再次被关闭时才会触发重新开仓。仓位管理方面，重新开仓时会沿用原仓位的手数、方向和交易品种，但没有对重复开仓次数进行限制的机制。资金管理方面，该EA没有内置的风险控制逻辑，不会根据账户余额或风险敞口调整仓位大小，持续重新开仓可能导致无限风险敞口。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a signal-driven strategic trading program but rather a position management utility. Its core concept is to automatically re-open a position in the same direction after it is closed, maintaining continuous market exposure. Entry conditions are not based on technical indicators or market analysis but are triggered by detecting when a position has been closed. Exit conditions similarly do not involve strategic exit logic; positions only trigger re-opening when they are closed again. In terms of position management, the re-opened position replicates the original lot size, direction, and instrument, but there is no mechanism to limit the number of re-opening cycles. Regarding money management, the EA has no built-in risk control logic and does not adjust position sizes based on account balance or risk exposure, potentially leading to unlimited risk exposure through continuous re-opening.

parameters.name: ReOpenMode
parameters.description: 重新开仓模式：所有仓位或仅手动关闭的仓位
parameters.description_en: Re-open mode: all positions or only manually closed

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA的魔术编号，用于标识自身管理的仓位
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying managed positions

parameters.name: LotMultiplier
parameters.description: 重新开仓时的手数倍数

parameters.name: IncludeSL_TP
parameters.description: 重新开仓时是否设置原来的止损和止盈
parameters.description_en: Whether to restore original SL and TP on re-open

pros: 自动化仓位恢复，减少人工干预需求
适用于需要持续维持市场敞口的交易场景，如套利或对冲策略的辅助
可以设置手数倍数，提供一定的仓位调整灵活性
支持自定义魔术编号，避免与其他EA冲突
pros_en: Automates position recovery, reducing the need for manual intervention
Useful for scenarios requiring continuous market exposure, such as auxiliary support for arbitrage or hedging strategies
Lot multiplier parameter provides some flexibility in position sizing on re-entry
Supports custom magic numbers to avoid conflicts with other EAs
cons: 没有开仓次数上限，可能无限循环重新开仓导致巨大亏损
缺乏风险控制逻辑，不考虑账户余额和整体风险敞口
市场趋势已改变时仍机械地重新开仓，可能逆势操作
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一K线内反复开仓平仓
cons_en: No limit on re-opening cycles, potentially leading to infinite loops of closing and re-opening resulting in massive losses
Lacks risk control logic, ignoring account balance and overall risk exposure
Mechanically re-opens positions even when market conditions have changed, potentially trading against the trend
No new bar check mechanism, risking repeated open-close cycles within the same bar
improvements: 增加最大重新开仓次数限制，防止无限循环
添加账户风险敞口检查，当亏损超过阈值时停止重新开仓
增加市场状态过滤，在趋势反转时不再盲目重新开仓
improvements_en: Add a maximum re-opening count limit to prevent infinite loops
Implement account risk exposure checks to stop re-opening when losses exceed a threshold
Add market state filtering to avoid blindly re-opening positions when trend reversals are detected

risk_points: 无开仓次数上限，仓位可能被无限次重新开立，在持续亏损行情中导致灾难性损失
不考虑账户资金状况和整体风险敞口，可能在小账户上开立过大的仓位
市场环境变化后仍机械重新开仓，可能在剧烈行情中持续逆势加仓
risk_points_en: No re-opening count limit; positions can be re-opened infinitely, leading to catastrophic losses in sustained losing markets
Ignores account balance and overall risk exposure, potentially opening oversized positions on small accounts
Mechanically re-opens regardless of changed market conditions, potentially compounding losses in volatile markets

summary_en: This EA is a utility tool that re-opens positions after they are closed, either manually or by stop loss/take profit hits. It monitors closed positions and replicates them with the same direction, volume, and instrument, functioning as a position recovery or persistence tool rather than a strategy-based trading system.
